plugins.name: neo-dev-toolkit
plugins.description: Opinionated Claude Code toolkit for software development: orchestrate a specialist agent team (neo), brainstorm ideas, iteratively improve outputs, generate + sync API docs to Confluence, drive GitLab MR workflows via glab, manage Jira/Confluence from the terminal via acli, scaffold a new Go service skeleton from a template (init-project), and migrate an existing service onto that hexagonal structure (migrate-project).
